BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is

hereby amended by changing all of the Residential/Commercial Planned Development 1006

District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 3-F in the area bounded by

             West Elm Street; North Cleveland Avenue; West Oak Street; North Cambridge
             Avenue,

to those of a DR-3 Downtown Residential District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance takes effect after its passage and due publication.
